review_scope: Source-free narrow code/profile diff, telemetry/kill/cleanup controls and unchanged asset/request recipes. No natural source bodies, values, questions, references or model answers inspected.
policy_assessment: This is a real relaxation of the application watchdog. The kernel hard cap stays unchanged, but total-boundary observations and increasing max events become diagnostic. This does not prove reclaimability, full-model fit, per-project isolation or reader competence.
review_checks: Required max/oom/oom_kill counters reject missing, malformed, negative, duplicate and invalid typed values. Actual total/max and max counts remain recorded.
Total equality/temporary excess and increasing max alone do not stop; exact kernel memory.max remains 8 GiB and mismatch still stops.
All three counters are compared against the immediately preceding accepted snapshot, including pre-asset and prelaunch; a max fall after a rise fails even above the initial value.
Sampling is serialized around telemetry only. HTTP and asset reads do not hold the sampling lock; watchdog resource failure kills the original inner group independently of blocked HTTP.
Nine-component proxy, 4.25 GiB reserve and owned-group RSS, 7 GiB proxy threshold, 5.5 GiB AS, time/CPU/log limits and anchored ownership/cleanup remain unchanged.
The endpoint whitelist and completion prohibition are unchanged. Kernel/cgroup writes, global cache changes and peer process signals are absent.
Pinned model digest and runtime/config recipes are unchanged; the inherited exact asset verification remains before Popen. This review did not rehash model/runtime assets.
Fixed authored request count and exact serialized digest are enforced during freeze; the independent mocked run also exercises that freeze assertion.
One configured external attempt destination, exclusive attempt marker, preserved full eight-row denominator and root-approved frozen hash remain required.
Owner initial 23-control evidence and the path-only correction plus one follow-up test are explicitly preserved; this review independently ran six current targeted controls.
remaining_limits: The proxy overlaps categories, omits ordinary unmapped clean cache and is not a certified upper bound on unreclaimable memory.
Nonatomic sampled counters can miss reset-and-reincrease or fast allocation changes between observations. A shared-cgroup OOM may affect a peer before the reactive watcher responds.

Unchanged numerical limits do not make the application policy equivalent or guarantee safety/fit; root accepted the residual-risk distinction and must separately decide on the concrete frozen attempt.
Even successful authored tokenization would not establish generation capacity, natural-prompt fit, semantic competence or QA quality.
